label: input token s at original positions 1-3
explanation: Fires only when the input token is s at original-phase positions t=1, 2 or 3. Never fires at t=0, at t>=4 in the original phase, on the delimiter, or (beyond 7 tiny activations at step 5 for L=3) in the copy phase, and never on any token other than s. Magnitude is largest at t=2 (62% of mass, top activations ~0.90 e.g. m n [s]), intermediate at t=3, and weakest at t=1, where it is often small or absent depending on the first token (most false positives are t=1). Somewhat lower when s is a repeat occurrence.

issues: The core claims check out on dev and test. All activation mass is on in_tok == s. The original phase holds 100% of the mass: t=1 has 5.3%, t=2 has 62.4%, t=3 has 32.3%. Nothing fires at t=0, at t>=4 or on <DEL>. The only copy-phase activations are 7-8 tiny ones at step 5 for L=3 (dev 7, test 8, values 0.05-0.18).

The false positives are not scattered noise. They are a deterministic class: all of them are at t=1, and whether t=1 fires depends entirely on the first token. With in_tok==s and t==1, dev precision is exactly 0.0 when first_tok is in {b, c, e, q, z, 0, 1} and exactly 1.0 for every other first token. This accounts for all ~3860 test false positives. Per-t test precision: t=1 is 0.770, t=2 is 1.000, t=3 is 1.000.

The explanation says t=1 is 'often small or absent depending on the first token' but never names the gating set, even though it is exact. It also hints that repeat occurrences of s fire less, which is not where the false positives come from. Once the t=1 first-token exclusion is added, precision is 1.0 with no in_first condition.
The label 'input token s at original positions 1-3' overclaims slightly. At position 1 the feature is silent after 7 of the 30 possible first tokens.
skeptic.revised_label: input token s at original positions 1-3 (strongest at 2). At position 1 it is suppressed when the first token is one of b, c, e, q, z, 0, 1

final_label: input token s at original positions 1-3 (strongest at 2). At position 1 it is suppressed when the first token is one of b, c, e, q, z, 0, 1
